51271709.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Pseudomonas aeruginosa tRNA (guanine(37)-N1)-methyltransferase (Leu5 to Asp25 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) Rosetta T1R cells by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR). SPR analysis was performed using a BIACORE T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) equipped with a CMS-S sensor chip. The surfaces of all flow cells were activated for 7 min with a 1:1 mixture of 0.1 M NHS and 0.1 M EDC at a flow rate of 10 μL/min. Anti-His antibody was captured on all surfaces to ~12000 RU. Surfaces were then blocked with a 7 min incubation of 1 M ethanolamine, pH 8.0. The protein TrmD, at a concentration of 1 μM, in 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 1 mM DTT, and 0.05% Tween-20, was captured on the anti-His antibody surface to a density of ~2200 RU. Flow cell no. 1 was left blank to serve as a reference surface. Different concentrations (2-fold dilutions) of the test analyte were injected from lowest to highest concentration in the same buffer over the flow cell at 30 μL/min for a contact time of 30 s and dissociation time of 240 s. Analysis of inhibitor binding affinity to TrmD was quantified using 2-fold dilutions. Data were collected at a rate of 10 Hz, and at a temperature of 25 °C. The K_D value was calculated using steady-state affinity fit.
